outline:
1. 電力系統品質項目與定義2. 電壓降與停電3. 電壓不平衡4. 電力諧波5. 頻率變動6. 電壓閃爍7. 暫態過壓8. 電力品質監控
1. Terms and definitions of power systems quality2. Voltage sags and interruption3. Voltage unbalance4. Power harmonics5. Frequency deviation6. Voltage flicker7. Transient overvoltages8. Monitoring of power quality
schedule:
第1週:introduction, objects, important issues of power system
quality.
第2週:overview of existent power system crital power quality
problems and affections.
第3週:power outage problem survey , related indices evalutations
and affection factors and import parameters determinations.
第4週:causes and classification of power outage, improved
strategies and practical feasible measures for reducing power
outage.
第5週:fundamental theory of voltage variations on power system, root
causes to produce voltage variations, classification of
voltage variations.
第6週:definitions for various indices of voltage variations and
their calculation.
第7週:analysis and simulation method for voltage variation with
respect to various types of voltage variations. affections
evaluations.
第8週:study of phase unbalance problems (fundamental theory, causes
and classification).
第9週:Review and midterm examination and report (期中考試)
第10週:study of phase unbalance problems (analysis and simulation
methods, and indices definitions).
第11週:study of phase unbalance problems (affections assessment and
improved strategies).
第12週:survey on waveform distortion problems: fundamental theory,
indices definitions, causes and analysis methods.
第13週:affections of power harmonics, transient and other type of
distortions of voltage and current waveforms.
第14週:local and international standard of power harmonics,
improved strategies and practical case studies.
第15週:planning and design of harmonic filters of practical
problems.
第16週:frequency variation issue on power system: causes study and
affections assessments.
第17週:the frequency control methods in utility and customer and
their availbility and investment evaluations.
第18週:Final examination and report (期末考)

remarks: 本課程依進度進行授課，以課堂講解為主，輔以資料補充。教學要點如下：1.電力系統品質探討議題及實務問題點之解說以建立學生基觀念。2.理論分析、數學推導及模型之建立。 3. 電力系統品質分析方法及解題技巧，並能判讀系統特性及相關參數影響評估。
